reforms.description: The tax reform introduced significant changes to corporate taxation, reducing marginal statutory tax rates and simplifying the tax system, which is expected to spur greater investment. Additionally, the establishment of a national innovation office aims to enhance coherence and continuity in the implementation of the national innovation strategy.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: A coherent national innovation strategy can streamline efforts and improve outcomes in innovation.
reforms.status_evidence: The national innovation office has been established and is operational.
reforms.importance_rationale: The creation of a national office represents a significant structural change in innovation governance.
reforms.source_quote: The main thrust of the reforms reduced marginal statutory tax rates for personal and corporate income, which combined with simplification will reduce distortions embedded in the tax system and spur greater investment.
reforms.cross_verification_note: The establishment of a national innovation office aims to enhance coherence in the implementation of the national innovation strategy, which aligns with innovation instruments for firms.

all_reforms_including_excluded.description: The tax reform enacted in late-2017 is expected to put government-sponsored enterprises (GSEs) under financial pressure due to a reduction in the corporate tax rate, which will trigger a large write-down on their tax-deferred assets. The reform aims to normalize housing finance by recommending the privatization of GSEs and subjecting them to the same regulations as other mortgage-backed securities issuers.
all_reforms_including_excluded.growth_orientation_rationale: While the reform aims to normalize housing finance, it may create financial pressures that could hinder investment in GSEs.
all_reforms_including_excluded.status_evidence: The reform has been publicly announced but not yet implemented.
all_reforms_including_excluded.importance_rationale: This reform represents a significant change in the regulatory framework for GSEs.
all_reforms_including_excluded.source_quote: The last Economic Survey recommended leaving the securitisation of mortgages to the private sector.
all_reforms_including_excluded.cross_verification_note: The reform primarily concerns housing finance and the privatization of GSEs, which does not relate to R&D funding or innovation instruments.
